title: NHL Logo Quiz Part 3: Hard Mode
headline: NHL Logo Quiz Part 3: Name The Team From A Tiny Piece Of Its Logo
description: A hard NHL logo quiz: eight tiny pieces of NHL team logos, about 2% of each logo. Guess the team, tap to reveal the answer, keep score and share your result.
intro: Every piece below is a small square cut from a current NHL team logo, about one fiftieth of the whole mark. No full letters, no team names, no giveaways. Each piece still holds one real detail, a color pair, a curve or an edge that belongs to only one team.
Make your guess, then tap Show The Answer. Be honest and mark whether you got it, and your score adds up at the bottom.

readMore.label: How Every NHL Team Got Its Name

items.piece: The gold outline of the panther's head, against navy.
items.fact: In 2016 the Panthers put their cat inside a shield inspired by the patch of the Army's 101st Airborne Division, in which owner Vinnie Viola served.

items.piece: Two navy rings with white between them, at the lower left of the circle.
items.fact: For 2022-23 the Oilers made royal blue, the color of their 1980s Stanley Cup teams, their main color again.

items.piece: The red, white and blue where the H meets the top of the C.
items.fact: The H stands for hockey, from Club de Hockey Canadien. The crest's current shape dates to 1956.

items.piece: Gold, white and navy edges along the bottom of the cat's jaw.
items.fact: The saber-toothed cat honors a fang and leg bone found in 1971 under a downtown Nashville building site.

items.piece: The red curve at the bottom of the J, with its black outline.
items.fact: The Devils' logo joins an N and a J, with horns on the N and a pointed tail on the J. Black replaced the original green trim in 1992.

items.piece: The orange stick and the top of the puck, against blue.
items.fact: The Islanders' crest shows a map of Long Island and has been the team's logo since the franchise began in 1972.

items.piece: The left point of the chevron: black outline and silver.
items.fact: The Kings unveiled their current logo in June 2024. It brings back the Gretzky-era chevron with an updated version of the 1967 crown.

items.piece: The red field, a blue stripe and the white edge at the right side of the shield.
items.fact: The lettering on the Rangers' shield comes from the club's original 1926 crest.
